proposals.description: Original DSMZ906 and ingredient825 preserve five waters. Independent ILO/WHO ICSC1220 explicitly identifies trisodium citrate pentahydrate, CAS6858-44-2 and C6H5Na3O7.5H2O. FAO/JECFA instead says pentahemihydrate and is not corroboration of the five-water identity. Bounded OLS exact-form search has no hit. A distinct CAS owner anchored by ICSC with asymmetric parent mapping completes the work; anhydrous, dihydrate and pentahemihydrate forms remain distinct. Source identity is CAS6858-44-2; the nearest parent CHEBI53258 is not the hydrate identity.
